The Chair announced the unfinished business to be the consideration of the veto. (consideration: CR H211-212)

POSTPONED PROCEEDINGS - At the conclusion of debate on the veto message of the President to H.R. 504, the Chair put the question on will the House, on reconsideration, pass the bill, the objections of the President to the contrary notwithstanding. Under the Constitution, the vote must be taken by the yeas and nays. Further proceedings were postponed until a time to be announced.
The previous question was ordered without objection.

DEBATE - Pursuant to a previous order of the House of January 2, 2026, the unfinished business is the further consideration of the veto message of the President on H.R. 504. The House proceeded with one hour of debate on the objections of the President to the contrary notwithstanding. (consideration: CR H208-209)
The Chair laid before the House the veto message from the President.

POSTPONED CONSIDERATION OF VETO MESSAGE - The Chair announced that further consideration of the veto message and the bill, H.R. 504, is postponed until the legislative day of January 8, 2026. Agreed to without objection.
The Chair announced that the objections of the President to H.R. 504 would be spread at large upon the Journal and the veto message would be printed as a House Document (119-120).
The Chair laid before the House the veto message from the President. (text: CR H6136)

dimensions.assessment: Directly affects the Miccosukee Tribe of Indians and management of a specific area within Everglades National Park.
dimensions.evidence: Miccosukee Tribe of Indians, must take appropriate actions to protect structures within the Osceola Camp from flooding

dimensions.assessment: Provides localized protection from flooding and adjusts administrative boundaries for tribal land use.
dimensions.evidence: take appropriate actions to protect structures within the area described in section 4(4)(C) from flooding

dimensions.assessment: Requires federal action for flood protection work, though specific cost amounts are not stated.
dimensions.evidence: the Secretary, in consultation with the Tribe, shall take appropriate actions to protect structures... from flooding

dimensions.assessment: Amends the Miccosukee Reserved Area Act to encompass an additional named campground tract.
dimensions.evidence: amend the Miccosukee Reserved Area Act to authorize the expansion of the Miccosukee Reserved Area

dimensions.assessment: Permanent boundary expansion with a two-year deadline for completing flood protection actions.
dimensions.evidence: Not later than 2 years after the date of enactment of this subsection

missing_information: Estimated financial costs for flood protection construction
importance_detail.rationale: Expands the Miccosukee Reserved Area to include Osceola Camp and mandates actions to protect its structures from flooding.
